plugins.photosPermission: Allow the app to access your photos so you can attach receipt images to expenses.
plugins.cameraPermission: Allow the app to access your camera so you can photograph receipts.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow the app to use your location to track a trip's route and calculate its mileage while you're using the app.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow the app to use your location in the background so it can automatically detect when you start and stop driving, if you turn that on in Settings.
